title: Iceland Airwaves Full Schedule & Planner
text:
#| include: false library(DT)
schedule <- read.csv(“schedule.csv”, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) schedule\(highlight <- tolower(trimws(schedule\)highlight))
render_schedule <- function(target_day) { df <- subset(schedule, day == target_day)
df\(Artist <- ifelse(
    df\)highlight == “yes”, sprintf(“⭐ %s”, df\(artist),
    df\)artist )
df <- df[, c(“time”, “venue”, “Artist”, “highlight”)] names(df) <- c(“Time”, “Venue”, “Artist”, “Highlight”)
DT::datatable( df, options = list( pageLength = 100, dom = “ft”, ordering = TRUE, responsive = TRUE ), escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE ) }
